question: if a finalist NR appeared tomorrow, could this campaign qualify it?
answer: THE GATE IS READY AND NOTHING CAN CALL IT.

exercised_directly.case: RUBBER STAMP -- every condition asserted true, no evidence at all
exercised_directly.result: NR-derived candidate; promotion refused. ALL TEN conditions fail.
exercised_directly.reading: a bare boolean is not believed, which is the whole point of the module

exercised_directly.case: UNDERSTATED ACCOUNTING -- counted_bytes 1 against a 4096-byte artifact
exercised_directly.reading: the accounting check is real and catches the exact lie NX exists to prevent

exercised_directly.case: HIDDEN PARENT -- external_references naming the resident's parent directory
exercised_directly.reading: the clause that makes NX standalone rather than a wrapper actually bites

exercised_directly.case: FULLY EVIDENCED -- correct bytes, matching sha256, empty external_references, a receipt per condition
exercised_directly.reading: the NEGATIVE CONTROL. A gate that refuses everything is not a gate. This one can say yes, so its refusals mean something.

the_field_absence_rule: check_no_hidden_parent returns False when external_references is ABSENT, with the reason 'absence of a field is not absence of a parent'. That is the defaulted-field trap handled correctly, and this campaign has been bitten by the opposite three times.

so_what_blocks_G012.not_the_gate: it is built, tested, and refuses what it should while still able to pass
so_what_blocks_G012.blocker_1: NO CANDIDATE. G012_CAPABILITY_CLIFF: the lowest capability-passing point in the campaign is 3.2831 complete EBPW against a <=1.5 tolerance, and every candidate below 1.5 failed the conjunction. There is nothing to hand the gate.
so_what_blocks_G012.blocker_2: NO CALLER. G023_NX_PROMOTION_HAS_NO_CALLER: the module is imported by nothing but its own test and is not registered as a tool, so neither HCLI nor any pipeline can invoke it even when a candidate exists.
so_what_blocks_G012.blocker_3: SEARCH SPACE. G027_REACHABILITY_ARITHMETIC: no allocation of Q4-and-above rates between the two organs reaches either gate, so the class of representation has to change before a candidate can exist at all.

what_this_adds: G012's evidence was '(none yet)'. It now has one thing: the terminal step is NOT the risk. The ten-condition contract works today. The campaign is short a candidate and a call site, not a qualification mechanism.
scar: CHECK THAT THE LAST STEP WORKS BEFORE BLAMING THE SEARCH. A ready gate changes what the blocker is.
